# The runtime of C applications generated by Clarity: records and storage
# in SQLite, queries, migrations, pictures and files, the binding to the
# screen, and the shell that shows the web renderer in a webview. Written by
# hand once and copied into every generated project. This file builds it on
# its own, with its tests:
#
#   cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(clarity_runtime LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(clarity.cmake)

enable_testing()
file(GLOB CLARITY_TESTS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS tests/*.c)
add_executable(clarity_tests ${CLARITY_TESTS})
# The HTTP test runs its own small server on a thread.
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(clarity_tests PRIVATE clarity clarity_shell clarity_engine clarity_http Threads::Threads)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(clarity_tests PRIVATE ws2_32)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(clarity_tests PRIVATE CLARITY_CONFORMANCE="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../conformance")
add_test(NAME clarity_tests COMMAND clarity_tests)
